{{Top|leg}}
'''Generation ships''' were an ancient class of [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] used to colonize [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] prior to the advent of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel. They were massive ships utilizing different compartments for growing [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], primary and secondary [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], living quarters, and entertainment modules. The main purpose of its design was for the primary and future generations to teach their progeny how to run the ship and colonize worlds. The knowledge was passed down until the destination was reached and the colony was established.

{{Ship-stub}}

==History==
The Great Generation ships<ref name="Eruption" /> (and later [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]]<ref name="DOTJ0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref>) were regularly launched by the [[Settled Worlds]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] from the planet [[Furies Gate]] during their pre-Republic isolation. These ships attempted to fly through the maze that was the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and reach the rest of the galaxy.<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref>

In the midst of their occupation by [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] circa [[30,000 BBY]], ambitious [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] experimented with early "generation ships" that traveled entirely at [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] and took [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] to reach their target destinations.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The world of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]] was first colonized before [[27,000 BBY/Legends|27,000 BBY]] by explorers out of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] traveling in the first generation ships, leading to the discovery of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. This carbonite paved the way for [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] colonization instead. <ref name="TEA" />

Settlement of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] began via generation ships sent out from the [[Arrowhead]] with planets such as [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. The wellsprings of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] were established by the explorers when colonization depended on generation ships and hibernating colonists.<ref name="TEA" /> In front of the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse/Legends|Hyperspace Navigator's Guildhouse]] is a [[Monument to lost navigators/Legends|Monument to Lost Navigators]], a massive carbonite statue of the ancient, unnamed patriarch of the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] family that allegedly blazed the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]] on a generation ship.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
